MnNSEReedArrivalText: REED: TAMARACK? Can you clear a spot? I've got something I can't set down sideways.
MnNSEReedAfterText: REED: Can I leave it with you? I said I'd be back at the gate when the shift came up. I'd like to get there before they tell me there's no room.
MnArcRCWaitingText: REED: VOSS asked what she could move. He didn't ask whether she'd done mine work. I should've asked him what he needed her for.
MnArcRCPathsText: REED: The foreman came up and said every spot on the drill was taken. A woman at the gate gave me a number. VOSS picked up. Asked how much rock my partner could shift. Said to bring her to MINNEAPOLIS.
MnArcRCChallengeText: REED: I said she could move more than me. He asked how much that was. I still don't know what he wants moved. You up for a match? I want to see what we've got before we go.
MnArcRCBeforeText: REED: Come on, girl. Look at me when you're ready.
MnArcRCWonText: REED: You got us. Easy, girl. Come over here. We'll let the nurse have a look before we walk to MINNEAPOLIS.
MnArcRCAfterText: REED: We're staying till the nurse gives us the all clear. VOSS can wait. If he wants to see her move rock, he can tell me where and why.
MnArcRCDeclinedText: REED: All right. We're staying a while anyway. Ask me again if you've got time.
MnNICEReedQuestionText: REED: You asked how much rock my partner could move. I thought you meant work at the mine. Wait. ELLIS? Is that you behind the door?
MnNICEReedAcceptText: REED: HALE paid me for half a shift last time. I carried steel till dark. Put the whole day's pay on the table and I'll take the job.
MnNICEReedAfterText: REED: VOSS can keep his badge. HALE said he'd be at UNION DEPOT in ST PAUL. I'll ask him for a turn on the drill myself.
MnNICEReedWonText: REED: Fine. I'm stepping back. I stood here and battled you. That's what I'll tell VOSS. What you do with the switch is on you.
MnArcSPBeforeText: REED: HALE says I get the next cut. He's finally letting me run the drill.
MINA: Did he tell you what happened to the last crew?
REED: He said the new pump could keep up.
MINA: I heard him say that about the old one.
MnArcSPReadyText: REED: I've carried steel since last winter. I'm taking my turn. You want a match before I go?
MnArcSPDeclinedText: MINA: All right. I'm staying with the pump. If HALE comes for it, I want him to tell me what he promised the next crew.
MnArcSPWonText: REED: You beat me. That doesn't put you in charge of my shift.
MINA: No. HALE is. Ask him what he did when the water came up.
MnArcSPAfterText: REED: I'll ask him what happened to the last crew. If he tells me the new pump can keep up, I'm asking how he knows.
MnArcSCBeforeText: REED: HALE said you walked off your shift. He sent me to bring you back.
SERA: The cage jammed. FINN held the ladder while I climbed out. He stayed to hold it for the next person.
REED: He didn't tell me the cage was stuck.
SERA: Then let me call NELL and find out if she's got it free. There's a phone inside.
MnArcSCChoiceText: REED is between SERA and the path to the station. Stand with her?
MnArcSCDeclinedText: SERA: If you see the BRAINERD ranger, tell her the mine needs a winch. FINN was still below when I came up.
MnArcSCStandText: REED: Fine. Make your call. If HALE asks, you told me the cage was stuck.
SERA: It is, REED. You can tell him that yourself.
MnArcSCReleasedText: SERA: Thanks. I'll try NELL first. If she can't get the cage moving, I'll call the BRAINERD ranger for a winch.
MnArcSCAfterText: SERA: NELL was at the shaft when I came up. If you get there before I get through to her, ask whether she's heard from FINN.
MnNDrillReedWorkText: REED: I signed for this run. Keep the drive moving.
MnNDrillReedWonText: They saw that. There goes the promotion.
MnArcHarborIntakeText: IVY: Harbor, it's IVY. I'm at the intake. The drill's still turning and the crew can't get past it.
Send the readings to the shelter. I'll listen here.
MnArcLinkReadyText: Hale steps away from the receiver.
Send the pump readings to ELLIS and IVY?
MnArcLinkText: ELLIS: I have both readings. I'll stay on the radio.
IVY: REED's still by the drive. Come down through the service hatch. Stop at the landing and call to me before you go any farther.
MnArcLinkAfterText: IVY: Shelter, leave the hatch open. FINN's bringing the crew up on foot. If the trainer's coming down, tell them to stop at the landing. I'm by the controls.
MnArcFinalReadyText: REED is holding the local drive. Your team ready?
MnArcFinalDeclinedText: IVY: The medic is upstairs. We will hold here.
MnArcFinalAfterText: REED: Fine. Touch it. See who gets paid for this mess.
MnArcFinalLockedText: REED: The chief is at the receiver. This floor is closed.
MnArcIntakeSeenText: The drive hammers. A pale shape pulls against the intake bars.
IVY: KETTLURK is caught in its own current. Shut the drive before we open the gate.
MnArcIntakeReadyText: Stop the drive and release the intake gate?
MnArcIntakeDeniedText: REED is still guarding the local drive.
MnArcIntakeOpenText: The drive stops. The intake gate lifts.
IVY: Clear the channel. Give it room.
MnArcIntakeEscapeText: KETTLURK folds into the returning water. The cage is empty.
IVY: The pull has eased. The crew can cross.
MnArcIntakeCrewText: FINN: That's the last one up. I'll call NELL and give her the names.
ELLIS: I've got both pump crews. North line's off. South line's off too.
JO: Tell them we'll be here when they get back.
MnArcIntakeReedExitText: IVY: Leave the badge on the rail, REED. You'll need both hands on the stairs.
REED: Here. If VOSS wants it back, he can come down for it.
MnArcIntakeDoneText: The current settles. The lakes are no longer feeding the pumps.
ELLIS: The readings are public. We will keep the line open.
MnArcIntakeAfterText: IVY: The cage stays open. We are removing the winch next.
MnArcIntakeIvyText: IVY: I came to find my crew. They sent us to build this.
MnArcIntakeFinnText: FINN: The repaired meter matches ELLIS now.
This time we get to stop when the gauge says stop.
MnArcAftermathText: REED: They kept the last pay. Said the equipment was my responsibility.
I wanted a team that made people listen.
Now every station knows my name.
Do not ask me to thank you.
MnArcSeraWaitingText: SERA: I started up with the lamp. FINN called for me to leave it. I set it back on the rung and saw two hands reach out. I couldn't see who was behind him.
MnArcTamarackAfterText: TAMARACK: The crew's safe. IVY called from the shelter. I checked the nest by the river after we hung up. The water's still below it. I left my waders out for tomorrow.
MnArcEllisAfterText: ELLIS: I tried taking a night call again. Couldn't stand the sound of the phone in that empty room. The new dispatcher sat with me till the next one came.
MnArcJoAfterText: JO: ELLIS used to leave his boots pointing at the door. He still does when he's had a bad night. This morning I found them under the table.
MnArcMinaAfterText: MINA: I heard FINN on the shelter radio. He asked if the old pump could be fixed. I said the ring was still in two pieces. Neither of us had anything to say for a while.
MnArcNellAfterText: NELL: I heard FINN give the count. He always starts at the bottom of the ladder and works up. I could tell who was on each step just by the order he said their names.
MnArcHabitatText: AIDE: That's GILLPUP. I found it in a nest on the dry bank. The mud was still damp underneath. It backed away when I reached for it, so I set a basin down and gave it room. It climbed in by itself.
MnArcHabitatAfterText: AIDE: GILLPUP used to sleep with its chin on the rim. Look. It's all the way in the basin now. I'll ask IVY to look at the bank with me before we take it home.
MnArcSPBattleText: REED: Back from the loading step. We've got room here on the platform.

scene_contracts.purpose: Competition over trust and status; Reed wants a paid training contract.
scene_contracts.consequence: Player earns the delivery responsibility Reed wanted.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed names the Minneapolis interview before traveling there. Ivy tends displaced Gillpup and worries about her missing crew.
scene_contracts.consequence: Refusal preserves the challenge; defeat never grants victory. The interview remains his destination.

scene_contracts.purpose: The appointment becomes recruitment. Reed knowingly identifies Ellis to ICE.
scene_contracts.consequence: Ellis is held in the headquarters; the player must reach the relay and physically free them.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed defends the institution that gave him authority.
scene_contracts.consequence: Power shutdown and Ellis release are separate actions. Reed leaves for the St Paul transfer.

scene_contracts.purpose: Mina confronts Reed about Finn and the northbound crew.
scene_contracts.consequence: Victory does not accept Mina's request; the player must acknowledge that separately.

scene_contracts.purpose: The player interrupts Sera's forced transfer before the fifth badge.
scene_contracts.consequence: Sera visibly leaves custody; Reed withdraws without apologizing. Refusal leaves the scene retryable.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed knowingly guards the endangered lift crew in exchange for promotion.
scene_contracts.consequence: Independent haulage, ventilation, feed and drive operations lead to Finn and Nell's rescue.

scene_contracts.purpose: A physical locking cradle and Ivy's live radio call connect the mine machinery to Kettlurk's confinement.
scene_contracts.consequence: The crew awaits shutdown at the Boundary intake; evidence alone cannot release them.

scene_contracts.purpose: The chief falls and Ellis establishes a live radio link.
scene_contracts.consequence: The hatch opens only after acknowledgment; neither the chief battle nor the link restores the survey.

scene_contracts.purpose: The player sees Kettlurk and the trapped crew, defeats Reed, and separately operates the local drive.
scene_contracts.consequence: The gate opens; Kettlurk visibly reaches water; Ivy and Finn move clear. Reed loses authority. Restoration waits for all acknowledgments.

scene_contracts.purpose: Tamarack, Ellis, Jo, Mina and Nell react to the changed region.
scene_contracts.consequence: Optional Reed encounter at St Cloud station is unrepentant; League member Halden and route trainers retain separate identities.

acceptance_contracts: Only active Minnesota species in Minnesota appearances; legal native moves and evolution levels.
No victory, release or restoration flags on refusal or loss.
Continue restores actor visibility, local gate state and completed crew movements.
No new paper-fetch gates; preserve the existing authored lairs and routes.
Ordinary-party campaign evidence must be earned through production controller input and kept separate from chapter fixtures.

grunts.seen: Put your PACK down. VOSS told me to take anything with a crew name on it. He made me open a lunch tin because somebody had scratched their initials in the lid.
ICE: Somebody scratched a name into that crate. VOSS made me sand it off. Said if I wanted to ask whose it was, he'd put my name there instead. Back away.
ELLIS asked me for the phone. I put his name on the board so the next shift would know he was waiting. VOSS wiped it off in front of me. Step away from the board.
Stay here. The last person who came down asking about a name got taken through that door. I watched him go in. I can't tell you where he went after that.
I used to take names at this desk. The last man who gave me his asked if he could go home for his coat. VOSS took him through before I could answer. What do you want?
They brought me this latch and told me to take the handle off the inside. I asked which door it was for. They told me to mind my tools. Get out of the bay.
The last person they brought down asked me to leave the back door open. I shut it. Now I'm waiting for the van again. Get back from the landing.
See the light on that relay? If it goes out, the bolt upstairs lets go. VOSS made me stand here and watch it. Hands off.
The drill shook the warning sign right off its post. The foreman sent me out to stand where it was. You're going back.
LODE: HALE told me to cut a ditch through the waste rock. I hit ledge and the water went under the path. I poked it with a shovel and the whole edge gave. That's why I'm standing here.
LODE: HALE saw copper in this and told us to keep cutting. I broke it off the face this morning. The back came away in my hand. He's only seen the shiny side.
There's a slab caught under the belt. HALE says to try starting it. Last time a piece shot back and took the lamp off my helmet. Stand clear.
Gauge hit red. The office asked if the bell rang. I said no. They told me to keep the pump running. You want to put your name on shutting it off?
LODE: Mind the jar. I filled it when the water first came up through the cut. Foreman said it was mud. I've been waiting to see what settled. Keep off this side of the rail.
LODE: Stay back from the edge. Yesterday I could see the bottom. This morning the water covered the white stripe on my pole. I marked that stripe so I'd know when to get help.
LODE: HALE told me to open the drain. I've stood at the other end of that pipe. It's right by the boat landing. He can come turn it himself if he wants it open.
The fan cut out twice this shift. Both times the dust stayed right where we were cutting. Wait here till you can see the far steps.
LODE: My lamp's going. If you're from the surface, stay put. The last blast knocked a chunk out of the roof just past me.
LODE: The foreman said to wait for the cage. I brought rope anyway. Hear that scrape? That's the cable winding without the cage. Keep back.
LODE: Two names still on the shift board. I heard somebody helping both of them down there. If there's a third name, I want to hear it before anybody tells me we're clear.
ICE: Stop at the rail. Somebody called from below. I caught the first word before the drill started up again. If you can hear the rest from there, tell me.
LODE: HALE told me to keep cutting wherever I saw copper. I can still see it from here. I can also see the water reach the rail. Keep to the steps.
ICE: I felt this rail kick when they started the pump. The man on the radio told me it always does that. I've stood here all week. It doesn't. Back up.
LODE: I put a pencil mark where the needle was. See it? That pipe's jumping and the needle hasn't left the mark. Keep your hands off the panel.
